topLine: DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus produces Lean proofs for 9 open Erdős problems and 44 OEIS conjectures.

items.headline: DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus produces Lean proofs for 9 open Erdős problems and 44 OEIS conjectures
items.summary: Google DeepMind researchers described a Gemini-based agent that writes proofs in Lean and uses compiler feedback. It autonomously resolved 9 of 353 open Erdős problems and 44 of 492 OEIS conjectures, at a few hundred dollars per problem. All proofs are formally checked in Lean, and humans reviewed the results. A peer-reviewed version was reported to appear in Science in October 2026.
